title: Final Condition for Fission
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and state the limiting condition for spontaneous fission as Z^2/A >= 43.3.

title: Binding Energy Interpretation
description: Important Criteria: The student should explain the components of the binding energy formula and their physical significance.

title: Energy Levels Discussion
description: Important Criteria: The student must discuss the two sets of energy levels in terms of rotational excitations and their implications for nuclear shape.

title: Potential Energy Sketch
description: Optional Criteria: The student should provide a rough sketch of the potential energy function V(ε) indicating the two-peak barrier.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign errors in the derivation of dB/dε and its implications for stability.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations and interpretations.

title: Moments of Inertia Values
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the moments of inertia values for the two sets of states as approximately 7 MeV and 3.3 MeV.

title: Physical Implications
description: Important Criteria: The student should discuss the implications of different moments of inertia on the stability and lifetime of the states.
